verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same and share the same flaws. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow has moved below the headline, which breaks the reading order, and it has shrunk to unreadable micro-type. The orange divider is stranded under the legal text at the bottom. The logo is tiny. The body copy is set nearly as large as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy, and the legal text is so big that it fills the lower third. The only differences are minor: B leaves a slightly bigger gap between the eyebrow and the headline, and the two wrap the legal text a little differently. Neither difference is meaningful.
